task_title: Unit-Rescaling No-Go Theorem and Search for Genuine Arithmetic Grade Coupling

pure_rescaling_definition.definition: Preservation of intrinsic arithmetic data a_{(K, n)} = a_n while changing solely the ambient unit of length via x -> tau^K * x
pure_rescaling_definition.coefficient_preservation: a_{n, K} = a_n for all n in Z^+, K in A_R

general_dirichlet_theorem.statement: For any intrinsic Dirichlet series D(s) = sum a_n n^(-s), the ambient-coordinate series factors as D_K^{amb}(s) = sum a_n (n tau^K)^(-s) = tau^(-Ks) D(s)
general_dirichlet_theorem.domain_of_validity: All finite partial sums, half-plane of absolute convergence, and meromorphic continuation domain
general_dirichlet_theorem.nowhere_zero_prefactor: tau^(-Ks) != 0 for all s in C

mellin_theorem.statement: For any Radon measure mu on (0, inf), the pushforward measure mu_K under x -> tau^K x satisfies M[mu_K](s) = tau^{K(s-1)} M[mu](s); for functions f_K(x) = f(x/tau^K), M[f_K](s) = tau^{Ks} M[f](s)
mellin_theorem.homogeneity: Mellin transform is homogeneous under real coordinate dilations

log_translation_theorem.statement: Translation by h = K*log(tau) in log-coordinate u = log x translates Laplace transform by e^(-s h) = tau^(-Ks) and Fourier transform by e^(-i xi h) = tau^(-i xi K)
log_translation_theorem.commutative_relation: n -> n*tau^K <==> u = log n -> u + K*log(tau) <==> D(s) -> tau^(-Ks) D(s)

grade_character.modulus: |chi_s(K)| = tau^(-K Re(s)) > 0 for all s in C

zero_divisor_corollary.multiplicity_preservation: mult_rho(D_K^{amb}) = mult_rho(D) for every zero rho in C

logarithmic_derivative_result.shift_type: Entire constant additive shift by K*log(tau)
logarithmic_derivative_result.residue_invariance: Res_{s=rho}[-(D_K^{amb})'/D_K^{amb}] = -mult_rho(D) identically for all K in A_R
logarithmic_derivative_result.singular_part_preservation: Principal part at all poles is strictly invariant across all grades

generic_base_result.statement: For any base b > 0, D_{b, K}^{amb}(s) = b^(-Ks) D(s) with b^(-Ks) != 0
generic_base_result.transcendence_independence: The unit-rescaling no-go theorem is a general property of real dilations, independent of the transcendence of tau = 2*pi

functional_equation.expression: Z_K^{amb}(s) = chi(s) tau^{J(1-s) - Ks} Z_J^{amb}(1 - s)

explicit_formula.expression: Spectral sum scales by tau^(-K rho); prime sum translates by K*log(tau); entire formula covariance

euler_product.intrinsic_product: prod_{(K, p)} (1 - N_K(K, p)^(-s))^(-1) = prod_p (1 - p^(-s))^(-1) = zeta(s) (INTRINSIC_CONSTANT)

weil_test_distributions.expression: Test functions g_K(x) = g(x/tau^K) scale homogeneously under quadratic form

coefficient_coupling_audit.finding: In all audited standard TC constructions, a_{n, K} = a_n identically across all fibers
coefficient_coupling_audit.ratio_independence: a_{n, K} / a_{n, J} = 1 for all n in Z^+, K, J in A_R
coefficient_coupling_audit.euler_factor_independence: L_{p, K}^{int}(s) = (1 - p^(-s))^(-1) is strictly independent of K

ambient_realization_kernel_audit.definition: ker(ev_tau) = { sum a_j [K_j] in A_R[A_R] : sum a_j tau^{K_j} = 0 } with ev_tau: A_R[A_R] -> R (or Q_bar[A_R] -> C)
ambient_realization_kernel_audit.search_scope: Euler special values, zero ordinates, von Mangoldt weights, gamma factors
ambient_realization_kernel_audit.finding: Special values zeta(2n) give ratios in Q*tau^{2n} with transcendental zeta(2n); zero ordinates have unknown arithmetic status (conjecturally transcendental, unproved), and log(p) is proved transcendental (Lindemann 1882); no standard zeta identity produces a non-trivial linear relation among tau^{K_j} with algebraic coefficients

falsification_and_counterexample_search.negative_control: Synthetic non-factorable family a_{n, K} = n^(K/2) yields D_K(s) = zeta(s - K/2) whose zeros move by K/2, confirming that genuine coupling moves zeros while unit rescaling preserves them

surviving_candidate: None among standard unit-rescaling structures. Any future viable TC route must formulate either non-factorable arithmetic coupling a_{n,K} != a_n or an authentic bridge into ker(ev_tau).
next_theorem: Pure unit rescaling cannot alter the zero divisor of any Dirichlet or Mellin transform. The TC research programme must focus exclusively on genuine arithmetic deformations or ambient cross-grade algebra.
